connector.name: Infraveil Agent Guard
connector.registryDescription: Gate an AI agent's destructive actions behind human approval, with a tamper-evident log.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package infraveil-guard. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the infraveilhq account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: INFRAVEIL_GUARD_THRESHOLD
env.description: Severity at/above which an action is gated: none|low|medium|high|critical (default high).

env.name: INFRAVEIL_GUARD_MODE
env.description: enforce (block dangerous actions pending approval) or audit (log only, never block). Default enforce.

env.name: INFRAVEIL_GUARD_HOME
env.description: Directory for the ledger and approval queue (default ~/.infraveil-guard).
